name: N8n Twitter Thread Repost
headline: n8n Twitter Thread Repost: Translate & Automate
short_description: Effortlessly extract, translate, rewrite, and repost entire Twitter threads in any language with this powerful n8n workflow. Instantly reach new audiences and automate your multilingual Twitter content. no manual copy-paste, just end-to-end automation. Perfect for creators and social media managers ready to supercharge their global presence
author: enescingoz

sections.overview:
This n8n workflow automates the entire process of extracting Twitter threads, translating them into your target language via OpenAI, rewriting them for clarity, and reposting them as new threads on your Twitter account. It eliminates manual copy-paste work and manages thread structure automatically, making multilingual content distribution seamless. The workflow integrates with Notion for data management and uses twitterapi.io for posting, costing approximately $0.016 USD per 15-tweet thread. Perfect for content creators reaching global audiences, social media managers handling multilingual campaigns, or anyone wanting to scale Twitter content across languages without manual effort.
Republish successful Twitter threads in multiple languages to reach new markets
Automate multilingual content workflows for social media teams
Translate and repost competitor or industry threads with proper attribution
Scale personal brand reach by distributing threads across language-speaking communities

sections.usage:
```
Create an n8n workflow that automates the process of extracting, translating, and reposting Twitter threads. The workflow should include the following steps: 1) Extract a Twitter thread from [USERNAME] with the ID [THREAD_ID], 2) Translate the thread into [TARGET_LANGUAGE], 3) Rewrite the translated thread to maintain the original tone and style, and 4) Republish the translated thread on Twitter. Ensure the workflow is compatible with the Twitter API and can handle multilingual content seamlessly.

sections.overview_vi:
